text:
Ava (Docs): quick heads-up — spotted ~30 occurrences of 'model name' vs 'model-id' across the SDK and guides. thinking we should standardize to `model_id` in code samples and `model name` in descriptive copy. thoughts?
Mike L: prefer `model_id` everywhere in code samples. avoid hyphens in identifiers.
Sara P: +1 for `model_id` in snippets. for user-facing prose I'd like `model name` (space) too. keep UX-friendly labels.
Leo - SDK: can update TS/py snippets in one PR if we have a list of files. also need to update the quickstart conf example and migrations guide.
Ava (Docs): plan: run a terminology lint to surface candidate files, then batch PRs by area (sdk, quickstart, guides). I'll run the lint and post results here. anyone object to that split? :eyes:
Mike L: split SGTM. maybe do SDK first, it's the highest risk.
Sara P: can we add a migration note (breaking change) for `model_id` naming in SDK v2? we'll need a short changelog snippet.
Ava (Docs): yes — suggested changelog blurb drafted below. please edit: "Migration note: SDK v2 renames model identifier parameter from `modelName`/`model-name` to `model_id`. Update your calls and config to the `model_id` field to ensure compatibility with the new runtime routing."
Leo - SDK: small nit — add a code example for both JS and Python. I'll add snippets to my PR.
docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — "standardize model identifier naming" by Ava (Docs) :sparkles:
Ava (Docs): thanks @Leo - SDK — when you push snippets can you include one-liner migration commands, e.g.:
```
# replace occurrences in repo
rg "modelName|model-name" -l | xargs sed -i "s/modelName/model_id/g; s/model-name/model_id/g"
```
Mike L: maybe also a short eslint rule or a remark-lint plugin to catch future regressions.
Sara P: +1 to lint rule. can we include it in the docs repo as a CI check?
Leo - SDK: I'll prototype a quick rule that flags `modelName` in JS/TS and add it to the docs CI job.
Ava (Docs): timing — aiming to merge SDK PR by EOW, guides PRs next week. tagging folks: @Mike L for SDK review, @Sara P for prose/changelog review.
Mike L: I'll review tonight.
Sara P: will leave feedback tomorrow morning.
Ava (Docs): final ask — if you notice any odd phrasing where we swap `model-name` -> `model_id` but it reads weird in product copy, flag it as a docs exception (we can keep `model name` in UX sentences). low risk. :+1:
Leo - SDK: pushed JS snippet update, PR #483. added unit test for param name mapping.
docs-bot: CI passed on #483 — all checks green.
Ava (Docs): awesome. once both PRs land I'll run a short grep to ensure no stragglers then follow up with a glossary entry update.
Mike L: ping me if you want an automated script to open per-folder PRs. I have one from last year we can reuse.
Ava (Docs): perfect — can you drop the script link here?
Mike L: https://internal.redwood.dev/tools/batch-prs (internal)
Ava (Docs): thanks — closing coordination loop. I'll post final checklist when done. :tada:
